EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 455 September 25, 1975
RECONSTITUTING THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE NATIONAL FORESTRY EXTENSION ADVISORY
BOARD CREATED UNDER EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 321 DATED MAY 31, 1971
WHEREAS, there is a need to expand the membership of the National Forestry Extension Advisory Board
created under Executive Order No. 321 dated May 31, 1971 in view of the participation of more agencies in
the Integrated Forest Conservation Information Program;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the law, do hereby reconstitute the membership in the National Forestry Extension Advisory
Board as follows:
The Dean, UPLB College of Forestry Ex-Officio
The Director, Bureau of Forest Development
The Commissioner, Forest Products Research & Industries Development Commission
The Director, Forest Research Institute
The Director, Bureau of Lands
The Director, National Food and Agriculture Council
The General Manager, Central Luzon-Cagayan Valley Development Authority
The Chief, Office for Civil Relations
The Director, Bureau of Soils
The Director, Bureau of Animal Industry
The Director, Bureau of Plant Industry
The Commissioner, National Air and Water Pollution Control Commission
The Director, National Media Production Center
The Director, Bureau of Broadcasts
The Director, Bureau of Elementary Education
The General Manager, National Power Corporation
The Representative, Secretary of the Department of Public Highways
The Representative, Secretary of the Department of Agriculture
The Representative, Secretary of the Department of National Defense
The Representative, Secretary of the Department of Local Government and Community Development
The Director, Bureau of Posts
The Director, Philippine Sugar Institute
The President, Rural Broadcasters' Council
The President, Rural Information Council
The Executive Secretary, Boy Scouts of the Philippines
The Representative, Secretary of the Department of Natural Resources
This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
